## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The status revision identifier should be fixed to match history and completion output, as its documented contract requires.

## Changes
The pull request adds a running-deployment status formatter with a revision identifier and attempt number, plus tests for attempt formatting.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the same revision length as history — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status()` shows `0123456`, while history and completion show `0123456789ab`. Your seven-character slice contradicts the helper’s promise to use “the same identifier as history.” — Users comparing a running deployment with its history must reconcile different identifiers for the same revision.
